notes: Both arms normalize the clean target to observed packet RMS for waveform loss and align one constant global phase. The phase shift used by the loss is detached. Paired weak spectrum/block-difference loss and observation/noise/diagnostic quality losses unchanged.

The only in-run learned mechanism difference is candidate stage projection. Real coefficient of received waveform clipped to [0.80,1.20] and its orthogonal complex residual to 0.75 raw packet RMS. This gives a stage energy floor without replacing received information with an arbitrarily amplified proposal. The bounds do not depend on dataset or scene.

Both arms use the same deployed gate, driven by 10 scale-free observed features. Eight native blocks supply edge power and spectral-flatness mean and dispersion, kurtosis, and between-block coherence. Packet autocorrelations add lags 1,2,4. Separate source U_s subsets of 512 each fit a 0.9 full/0.1 diagonal regularized covariance and the .995 novelty quantile. Gate is zero at or below source cutoff, smooth to full at double cutoff.
Same already exposed source V physical rows as s2026113121; WiSig 1800 mother-panel exposure still applies. No use of that panel for any weight or gate fitting.
